mechanism: Efek farmakodinamik aditif atau sinergis antara Insulin human dan Potassium citrate pada organ target fisiologis yang sama.
clinicalOutcome: Risiko hipoglikemia berat mendadak (keringat dingin, tremor, penurunan kesadaran, hingga koma hipoglikemik).
management: PEMANTAUAN RUTIN: Kombinasi umumnya aman. Tidak diperlukan perubahan rejimen terapi secara rutin; lanjutkan pengawasan klinis standar.
ddinterOriginalText: Limited data suggest that potassium repletion may partially or completely reverse glucose intolerance in some patients with liver cirrhosis. The effect of insulin may be potentiated, and the risk of hypoglycemia increased. The mechanism by which potassium improves glucose tolerance has not been established, but it apparently does not involve a further increase in the already excessive insulin secretion associated with cirrhosis. The implications for glucose intolerance in patients without liver cirrhosis are not known.
ddinterOriginalManagement: Minor clinical significance (DDInter Level 1). The combination is generally safe and well-tolerated without therapy alteration.
references: Nature Protocols (2022) - DDInter: an online drug-drug interaction database with chemical and clinical profiles.

mechanism: Interaksi farmakokinetik metabolisme lintas pertama pada mikrosom hepar antara Losartan dan Rifampicin.

mechanism: Pemberian bersamaan mempotensiasi gangguan hemostasis darah dan peningkatan risiko perdarahan antara Clopidogrel dan Heparin.
clinicalOutcome: Perubahan farmakokinetik ringan yang umumnya dapat ditoleransi dengan baik tanpa gangguan klinis signifikan.
management: PEMANTAUAN RUTIN: Kombinasi umumnya aman. Tidak diperlukan perubahan rejimen terapi secara rutin; lanjutkan pengawasan klinis standar.
ddinterOriginalText: The safety of the combined use of clopidogrel with heparin has not been established. In healthy volunteers, clopidogrel did not alter the effect of heparin-induced anticoagulation. Heparin did not alter inhibition of platelet aggregation due to clopidogrel. Although adverse events and interactions have not been reported with the combined use of these drugs, the clinician should exercise caution when these drugs are coadministered.
ddinterOriginalManagement: Minor clinical significance (DDInter Level 1). The combination is generally safe and well-tolerated without therapy alteration.

mechanism: Pemberian bersamaan menyebabkan peningkatan konsentrasi plasma/darah Amiodarone dan Telaprevir yang meningkatkan paparan terapeutik atau risiko akumulasi.
clinicalOutcome: Peningkatan risiko aritmia ventrikel fatal, pemanjangan interval QTc (Torsades de Pointes), sinkop, dan henti jantung mendadak.
management: KONTRAINDIKASI / HINDARI KOMBINASI: Pertimbangkan beralih ke obat alternatif yang tidak berinteraksi. Jika mutlak diperlukan, pantau tanda vital dan parameter laboratorium secara intensif.
ddinterOriginalText: Coadministration with the hepatitis C virus (HCV) NS3/4A protease inhibitor, telaprevir, may significantly increase the plasma concentrations of certain antiarrhythmic agents such as amiodarone, bepridil, disopyramide, and quinidine. The mechanism involves inhibition of CYP450 3A4 metabolism, as telaprevir is a potent inhibitor. The interaction has not been specifically studied, but could conceivably lead to serious and/or life-threatening reactions including cardiac arrhythmias and other toxicities if levels are significantly increased. The use of these antiarrhythmic agents has been associated with dose-related prolongation of the QT interval, thus elevated plasma levels may potentiate the risk of ventricular arrhythmias such as ventricular tachycardia and torsade de pointes as well as cardiac arrest and sudden death.
ddinterOriginalManagement: Major clinical significance (DDInter Level 3). Avoid combination or monitor intensively.
references: Nature Protocols (2022) - DDInter: an online drug-drug interaction database with chemical and clinical profiles.
Clinical Pharmacology & Therapeutics - DDInter 2.0 Monograph #1156
